subject: Stakeholder mapping & procurement checklist for Redwood evaluation
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Kapoor <aisha.kapoor@zenithretail.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@zenithretail.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T15:22:00-08:00
Subject: Post-call recap + stakeholder mapping request

Hi Aisha / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and a few asks so we can move to the next steps:

- Primary drivers: reduce inference cost per request, improve tail latency for peak traffic, and centralize model serving across teams.
- Target workloads: product recommendations (user-facing), search re-ranking, and a customer support summarization pipeline.
- Timeline: aiming for a pilot in Q1 2027 and a production rollout in Q2 if pilot results look good.
- Decision criteria: latency (p95 under 300ms), cost per 1M tokens, security/compliance posture, and ease of integration with current infra.

Actions we need from your side to accelerate:
1) Org chart / stakeholder list that includes the economic buyer and the procurement/legal contacts — who owns the approval for vendor contracts and budget?
2) Security contact for a technical security questionnaire and potential SOC2 evidence review.
3) Procurement process overview (PO vs Net terms, standard procurement lead time, any required PO wording).

If you can share the org chart and point us to the procurement/legal contacts this week, we’ll put together a tailored pilot plan and a short SOW + pricing for Hosted vs Dedicated options.

I’ve attached the call notes and the short Redwood one-pager for reference.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

Attachments: redwood_onepager.pdf, discovery_notes_zenith_20261201.txt

From: Aisha Kapoor <aisha.kapoor@zenithretail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@zenithretail.com>
Date: 2026-12-02T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + stakeholder mapping request

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. Per your asks:

- Economic buyer: Tom Reynolds (VP, Commerce) — he’s driving the budget for platform initiatives.
- Procurement: procurement@zenithretail.com (lead: Procurement Team)
- Security contact: Lena Morales (Head of InfoSec) — lena.morales@zenithretail.com
- Budget window: they’ve tentatively allocated budget for pilot in Q1 2027; final approval goes through CFO.

I’m attaching a simplified org chart (zenith_org_chart_v2.pdf) that highlights the stakeholders. I can introduce you to Procurement and Lena in a single thread — would you like me to make those intros now or after you share an initial SOW/proposal?

Also: high level, procurement prefers net-30 and needs a vendor W-9 and insurance certificate. Procurement may request vendor security docs (SOC2) and an executed DPA for data handling specifics.

Tom — any additions?

Thanks,
Aisha

Aisha Kapoor
Sr. Product Manager, Personalization | Zenith Retail
aisha.kapoor@zenithretail.com

Attachments: zenith_org_chart_v2.pdf

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-02T13:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + stakeholder mapping request

Looping in engineering to get aligned on the security ask.

Aisha — thanks for the details. For Lena’s team I can run a 45-minute security deep-dive to cover:
- Data flow diagram / where data is processed and stored
- Encryption (in transit & at rest) and KMS options
- Multi-tenant isolation and logging/audit capabilities
- SOC2 scope and any evidence we can share

Available slots: Tue 2026-12-07 09:00-10:00 PT, Wed 2026-12-08 11:00-11:45 PT, Thu 2026-12-09 14:00-14:45 PT. I’ll prepare our standard security questionnaire template and a short demo of the control plane.

Attaching: security_questionnaire_template.docx

—Dev
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Kapoor <aisha.kapoor@zenithretail.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@zenithretail.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, procurement@zenithretail.com
Date: 2026-12-03T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: Next steps & draft SOW / proposal

Great — thanks Aisha, Tom. I’ve attached a short draft proposal and SOW (redwood_proposal_zenith_v1.pdf) that outlines:
- Pilot scope: 4-week pilot on recommendation and reranking workloads
- Success criteria: p95 latency target, cost delta, and quality safeguards
- Two pricing options: Hosted API (usage-based) and Dedicated (committed capacity) with estimated numbers for your traffic profile

Next steps I propose:
1) Aisha — please introduce Procurement and Lena when convenient (we can do a 3-way intro). If preferred, we can send the SOW first and have Procurement review.
2) Rishi — can you prepare pricing for Dedicated vs Hosted and expected lead times for Dedicated capacity? (cc’d)
3) Dev — schedule the security deep-dive with Lena for one of the proposed slots.

Happy to hop on a 30-minute sync to walk through the SOW and answer any questions — I’m available Mon 2026-12-06 10:00-11:00 PT or Tue 2026-12-07 15:00-16:00 PT.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

Attachments: redwood_proposal_zenith_v1.pdf
